item.description:
0.12.0

  • Whole folders move both ways, with one question about same names per drop, and a transfer queue under the file list instead of a sheet.
  • Split panes (⌘D, ⇧⌘D) and broadcast input to every pane (⌥⌘I).
  • Agent forwarding now follows ForwardAgent in your ssh_config. Remote forwarding (-R) is in the port forwarding window.
  • Generate SSH Key and Install Public Key on Server.
  • Fixed: saved hosts lost their tunnels, colour and jump settings on restart.
